A 2-Day Beginner's workout plan designed specifically for people who'd like to workout at home with bands only.

It's all built with beginner-friendly movements, so you can get started even if you're new to these types of workouts. 

The workouts are short and sweet at around 30 minutes each, too.

22.name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Chest Fly
22.description:
1.Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended with a slight bend in your elbows.

2.Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your body in an arc-like motion until your elbows are at the same level of the bench. 

3.Bring the weights back above your chest.

4.Repeat.

25.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
25.description:
1) Sit on an incline bench set at 45 degrees. 

2) Start by holding the bar over your upper chest with your arms straight and grip slightly wider than shoulder width. 

3) Slowly lower the bar until the barbell makes contact with your upper chest. 

4) Then press the barbell straight up over your chest until your elbows are locked.

30.name: Machine Seated Chest Fly
30.description:
1.Sit at the machine with your back flat on the pad. Both hands holding the handles with elbows slightly bent.

2.Push the handles together and squeeze your chest once your forearms reach the middle. Pause.

3.Return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

34.name: Machine Seated Leg Extension
34.description:
1) For this exercise, ensure that the pad rests just above the ankle.

2) Secondly, you wanna make sure that the weights don’t tap down in between each repetition.

3) Keep a tall body throughout the exercise. 

4) Extend your knees fully, raising your legs straight out.

35.name: Seated Leg Press
35.description:
1. Sit on a leg press machine, and place your feet against the pad about shoulder-width apart. Make sure your knees are bent at the start of the exercise. 

2. Slowly push against the pad using your heels until your knees are almost straight.  Do not lock your knees straight at the peak of this exercise. Then move back into the start position.

3. Repeat for each rep.

46.name: Cable Straight Bar Tricep Pushdown
46.description:
1) Grip the bar in both hands at chest level with your elbows bent. 

2) Push the bar down, fully extending your arms and keeping your shoulders steady. 

3) Your hands should finish at the top of your thighs in the downward position.

50.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
50.description:
1) Stand up straight with arms hanging and dumbbells in both hands, palms facing in. 

2) Curl dumbbells for both arms at once, twisting your wrists on the way up and keeping your elbows still. 

3) Slowly lower repeat.

64.name: Cable Bicep Curl
64.description:
1.Stand facing the low pulley and attach a short bar to the low cable. Grasp the bar with your palms up and stand with your arms straight.

2.Bending on the elbows, curl the bar up towards your shoulders. Pause

3.Lower the bar returning to starting position.

4.Repeat.

68.name: Lat Pulldown Machine Wide Grip
68.description:
1) Grasp the bar using a shoulder-width grip with your arms extended straight overhead.

2) Pull the bar down in front to the top of your chest, bending at the elbows.

3) Straighten your arms fully, returning the bar to the top position.

79.name: Lying T-Bar Row
79.description: Rest your upper chest against the top of the pad and grab the handles. Pull the weight up and squeeze your back at the top of the movement. Pause, and return to the starting position.

81.name: Hyperextension Roman Chair Back Extension
81.description:
1) Lie face down on a hyperextension bench with your body in a straight line. Arms in a cross position in your chest.

2) Bend forward at the waist as far as you can. Make sure your back is flat at ALL times.

3) Then raise your body back up until your body is in a straight line again.

85.name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
85.description:
1.Kneel and grasp a cable rope attached to a high pulley, arms extended.

2.Curl your head and torso down to your knees, hands at the sides of your head.

3.Return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

87.name: Full Sit Up
87.description:
1) Lie on your back on the floor with your feet shoulder width apart. 

2) Begin by lifting your upper body up until you are sitting up straight with your arms either at your sides, crossed in front of you, or behind your head. 

3) Lower your body back to the floor. 

4) Make sure that you do not use your arms to swing your body up and make sure that your feet remain touching the ground at all times.

90.name: Decline Bench Oblique Crunch
90.description:
1.Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and hands together behind your head.

2.Raise your upper body off the bench and slowly twist it to one side.

3.Lower your body back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.

4.Repeat and alternate.

93.name: Machine Lying Leg Curl
93.description:
1.When performing the leg curl, what you wanna do is ensure that the bottom pad is just above the ankles and the top pad is above your knee. 

2.You don’t want the pad resting on your knee cap.

3.Also, ensure that the weights don’t tap down between your repetitions.

4. Keeping the torso flat on the bench, ensure your legs are fully stretched. 

5.Position your toes straight. This will be your starting position.

6.Begin by curling your leg up as far as you can.

7.Lower back to the starting position.

94.name: Machine Seated Leg Curl
94.description:
1.Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and sit on the machine with your back against the back support pad. Legs fully straight in front of you, back of lower legs on top of the padded lever. Grasp the side handles on the machine as you point your toes straight.

2.Curl your legs downward as far as possible.

3.Return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

96.name: Leg Press Machine Calf Raise
96.description:
1. Sit on a leg press machine, and place your feet against the pad about shoulder width apart. Make sure your knees are bent at the start of the exercise. 

2. Slowly push against the pad using the palm of your feet until your knee is almost straight. Then move back into the start position. Do not lock your knee straight at the peak of this exercise.

100.name: Machine Seated Reverse Fly
100.description:
1.Sit at a reverse position in a machine, chest against the back rest. Both hands holding the handles, elbows slightly bent.

2.Move your arms outward and backward in a reverse fly motion until your elbows go just past your back. Pause.

3.Slowly return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

114.name: Machine Incline Chest Press
114.description:
1.When performing this exercise, you wanna set up the machine so that the handles are in-line with the middle of your chest at the bottom of the press.

2.Also, make sure that the weights don’t tap down in between every repetition.

3.Start by pressing handles out until arms are extended.

4.Return to starting position.

117.name: Machine Seated Shoulder Press
117.description:
1.Sit upright at a shoulder press machine, holding the inside handles at shoulder height with your palms facing in and your elbows bent.

2.Press the handles overhead, extending your arms fully.

3.Lower the handles returning to starting position.

4.Repeat.

118.name: Machine Back Extension
118.description: Adjust seat so back pad fits between shoulder blades. Legs should be slightly bent. Place feet firmly on foot pad and move torso back slowly. Pause at extended position.

119.name: Lying Machine Abdominal Crunch
119.description:
1. Lie on the abdominal crunch machine, following the directions for the correct start position. 

2. Squeeze your abdomen, bringing your ribs down towards your pelvis. 

3. Slowly return to the start position under control and repeat.

122.name: Machine Seated Chest Press
122.description:
1) Sit upright making sure back is rested on the backrest, both hands holding the horizontal position handles and close to your shoulders, elbows bent.

2) Push both handles forward to a straight arm position in front of your chest.

3) Bending at the elbows, slowly return to starting position.

4) Repeat.

125.name: Machine Seated Neutral Grip Row
125.description:
1.Sit at a reverse position in a machine, chest against the backrest. Hands holding the vertical position handle, arms extended.

2.Pull the handles towards your chest, bending at the elbows. Pause.

3.Slowly return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

129.name: Roman Chair Side Bend
129.description:
1.Begin by standing up straight on your side, hands overhead, clasp together. 

2.Bend all the way down, full extension of the oblique. 

3.Turn up crunching. 

4.Repeat.

155.name: Lying Straight Leg Raise
155.description:
1. For this exercise, keep your core engaged, especially when you're lifting your feet up off the floor but also while they're returning and getting close to the ground again.

2. Lie with your back flat on a ground and your legs extended in front of you.

3. Place your hands on your sides with your palms down.

4. As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible, raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.

5. As you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.

241.name: High Plank
241.description:
1) When performing this exercise, you’ll want to maintain an active core which means glutes and abdominals on holding neutral spine.

2) Place your hands directly below your shoulders and maintain throughout.

3) Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight, feet together, hands on the floor.

4) Raise your body up into the top of a push-up position, on your hand and toes. Keep your back flat by drawing in your abdominals, and squeezing your glutes. Hold this neutral spine position actively.

253.name: BOSU Dome Up Crunch
253.description:
1) Sit on the front of the dome of the BOSU. Place your hands across your chest (easier), or place your fingertips by your ears (harder). Feet will stay on the ground throughout the exercise.

2) Roll back, laying out along the top of the BOSU while maintaining active abdominals.   

3) Breathe out and roll back up to a crunched position (rather than sitting all the way up). 

4) Repeat.

309.name: Burpee
309.description:
1.Start in the top of a push up position.

2.Jump your feet in, bringing your knees to your chest while keeping your hands on the floor.

3.Come to an upright position and jump into the air, raising your arms overhead.
 
4.Return to the mid position and then jump your feet back out to a straight position.

331.name: Jumping Jack
331.description:
1) Keep your arms extended. 

2) Jump from your legs.

332.name: High Knees
332.description:
1) Bring your knees to your hands rather than your hands to your knees.

2) Do the desired number of repetitions

333.name: Skater
333.description:
1) Jump side to side on one foot. 

2) Make sure your back foot doesn’t touch the ground.

342.name: Toe Tap
342.description:
1) When performing this exercise, keep your weight on the outside foot and minimize the weight on the toe on the ball. 

2) Hop and switch.

350.name: 3D Lunge
350.description:
1) 3D lunge has 3 separate lunges that you will perform. 

2) First, the forward lunge. Stepping forward, ensuring that your knee doesn’t go over top of your toes. Kneeling tall over top of the back leg. 

3) Return. 

4) Second is the side lunge. Step out, ensuring that your foot, knee and hip are all in line.  And sit your back behind you. 

5) Third, the reverse lunge. Step back and return to standing position.

353.name: Cross Body Mountain Climber
353.description:
1) For this exercise, ensure that your abdominals are on and tight. 

2) Bring your knee from one side of your body towards the opposite elbow.

3) Move your feet as quickly as you can.

354.name: Elbow Side Plank
354.description:
1) When performing the side plank, ensure that your body is in a straight line and your elbow underneath your shoulder. 

2) Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward in line with your body. 

3) Once in position and you have a nice straight line down your body, hold.

356.name: High Plank Jacks
356.description:
1) When performing this exercise, ensure that you keep your abdominals on and hips higher in a neutral position. That’ll prevent any lower back sway and back injuries. 

2) When you get into the plank position, set your hands underneath your shoulders. 

3) From there, alternate your feet jumping out and coming back together. 

4) Repeat.

363.name: Glute Bridge
363.description:
1) For this exercise, lie on your back. 

2) Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips. Keep your tummy tight throughout.

365.name: Bicycle Crunch
365.description:
1) For the bicycle crunch, sit on your pelvis or your sit bones with your feet off the ground and upper body tall. 

2) Bring opposite elbow to the opposite knee. 

3) Twist between your pelvis and your rib cage.

366.name: Hollow Body Hold Flutter Kicks
366.description:
1) For this exercise, you’ll come up in a V position. 

2) Sitting on your sit bones and your pelvis. 

3) Make sure that your abdominals are tight and pulled in, not leaning back, loading your lower back. 

4) From there, kick your legs in an alternate pattern.

369.name: Toe Crunch
369.description:
1) Lie in your back and as best as you can, straighten your legs up into the air. You might need to bend your knees if your hamstrings are too tight. 

2) From here, roll your rib cage up and reach for your toes and then back down. 

3) If it’s too easy, try reaching farther into the bottom of your feet.

407.name: Body Weight Squat
407.description:
1)  When performing the squat, let your body weight shift back into your heels as you sit your hips back. 

2) Keep your knees as far back behind your toes as possible. 

3) Keep your chest up and back held in neutral position or with a slight arch. 

4) Prevent yourself collapsing forward as you perform a squat. 

5) Make sure your toes, knees, and hips are all in line as you squat back.

411.name: Bodyweight Split Squat
411.description:
1)  While performing this exercise, ensure that your body is over top of your back leg. 

2) Keep all your lower body segments at 90 degrees. 

3) Extend up into a standing position. 

4) Repeat.

416.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
416.description:
1) When performing this exercise, ensure that your knee, feet and hip are in line. 

2) With your feet hip-width apart, place the instep of your rear foot on a bench. Your feet should be approximately three feet apart. 

3) Lower your hips toward the floor so that your rear knee comes close to the floor. 

4) Pause and drive through your front heel to return to the starting position. 

5) Repeat

420.name: Prisoner Squat
420.description:
1) Interlace your fingers behind your head.

2) Sit back and down by bending at the hips, knees, and ankles. 

3) Once you've reached the deepest position you can comfortably go, return back to a standing position by driving your feet into the floor.  

4) Repeat

421.name: Squat Jump
421.description:
1. Start by slowly descending into a squat by sitting back into your hips and knees. 

2. Push the floor away and fully extend your hips and knees, leaving the floor as you come upwards.

3. Land softly under control while keeping the knees in line with your hips and feet, not allowing them to cave inwards. 

4. Repeat for desired number of repetitions.

436.name: Wall Sit
436.description:
1) When performing this exercise, ensure your knees don’t move forward past your toes. 

2) Try to keep your knees at 90 degrees and hold.

439.name: Chin Up
439.description:
1.Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing your torso and a grip closer than the shoulder width, arms straight.

2.Pull your torso up until your head is around the level of the pull-up bar keeping elbows close to the body.

3.Lower your torso back to starting position.

4.Repeat.

446.name: Cable High-Low Chop
446.description:
1.Stand upright facing to one side holding a handle in both hands with your arms straight over one shoulder.

2.Pull the cable down from your shoulder to your opposite hip.

3.Concentrate on moving your hips and shoulders, not your arms.

4.Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other side.

455.name: Lat Machine Single Arm Close Grip Row
455.description:
1.Grasp the handle with your arm extended straight overhead, palm facing in. Lean back slightly and look up.

2.Pull the handle down in front to the top of your chest.

3.Straighten your arm, returning the handle to the starting position, going through a full range of motion. 

4.Repeat. Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other side.

468.name: Cable Front Raise
468.description:
1. Standing upright, grabbing the straight bar with both hands.

2.  Raise arm fully extended. Raise arm until hands are at eye level. Ensure core is tight while raising arm. 

3. Lower to starting position. Repeat.

491.name: Cable Rope Face Pull
491.description:
1.Stand upright holding a rope with your palms facing each other arms straight at shoulder height and your back flat.

2.Pull the rope straight in toward your face, bending elbows up and high, full extension.

3.Remain upright throughout and do not sway back and forth.

557.name: Cable Standing Rear Delt Crossover
557.description:
1.Stand upright holding the handles in front of your chest, arms straight.

2.Extend arms to the side, keeping them straight.

3.Return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

580.name: Cable Kneeling Rotational Row
580.description:
1.Kneel on one knee holding a handle in the hand on the same side with your arm straight and your back flat.

2.Pull the handle straight into your chest, elbows back and hand towards the shoulder.

3.Return to starting position by lowering the handle back to a straight-arm position.

4.Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other side.

582.name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Twisting Crunch
582.description:
1.Kneel holding a rope cable in front of you, elbows slightly bent.

2.Curl your head and torso down to one side towards your knees, keeping your hands at the sides of your head.

3.Return upright returning to starting position.

4.Repeat and alternate.

629.name: Alternating Single Leg Skater Squat
629.description:
1.Stand upright with one foot slightly off the floor.

2.Slowly lower your body into a squat position on the standing foot, keeping your back neutral/flat and the other foot off the floor.

3.Return to starting position, switch the feet, squatting down on the opposite leg. 

4.Perform one rep on one side, then switch to the other side. Alternate sides with each rep.

640.name: Kneeling Push Up
640.description:
1.Support your body on your knees and hands with your elbows bent, legs crossed, feet raised and your chest nearly touching the floor.

2.Push up to a straight arm position.

3.Lower your body returning to starting position.

4.Repeat.

651.name: Superband Shoulder Press
651.description:
1.Stand upright placing feet inside the band, should be shoulder-width apart, toes pointed. Hands holding both sides of the band at shoulder level, elbows bent and out

2.Lift the bands up until arms are fully extended overhead.

3.Return to starting position.

4.Repeat.

654.name: Superband Pull Apart
654.description:
1. Stand upright with arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the ends of the band with both hands.

2.Perform a reverse fly motion, moving your hands out towards your sides, keeping arms straight and parallel to the floor.

3.Return to starting position. Repeat.

678.name: Machine Seated Parallel Grip Shoulder Press
678.description:
1.Sit upright at a shoulder press machine, holding the inside handles at parallel grip position, fists facing each other and your elbows bent.

2.Press the handles overhead, extending your arms fully.

3.Lower the handles returning to starting position.

4.Repeat.

686.name: High Plank Alternating Single Leg Lift
686.description:
1.Support your body off the floor, resting on your toes and forearms.

2.Raise one leg straight up off the floor, keeping your body in a straight line and your back neutral/flat.

3.Lower back your leg to the floor returning to starting position.

4.Raise the opposite leg. Alternate sides with each rep.

2596.name: Butt Kickers
2596.description:
1. Stand with your legs shoulder-width apart. Your arms should be bent.

2. Flex the right knee and kick your right heel up toward your glutes. Bring the right foot back down.

3. Try to keep your knees in line with your body as best as you can.

4. As the right leg comes down, flex your left knee and kick your left foot up toward your glutes. 

5. Repeat.

2597.name: Running in Place
2597.description:
1. Try to be light on your feet.

2. Maintain proper posture as you run on the spot.

3. Pull your knee up until your toes are pointing to the floor then back to the ground.

4. As one foot touches the ground, start pulling up the other knee until your toes are pointing to the floor then back to the ground.

5. While doing this, make sure your arms are also moving.

6. Do this as quickly as you can.

2619.name: Squat to  Alternating Kick
2619.description:
1. When performing this exercise, ensure you have proper squat form. Sit your hips back and as you stand, ensure you pull your stomach in to engage your core.

2. To begin, bend your knees and sit back as far as you can, stand, then kick your right leg in front of you, foot flexed.

3. Repeat, kicking with your left leg, and continue alternating.

2620.name: Reverse Lunge with Straight Leg Kick
2620.description:
1. When performing this exercise, ensure proper lunge form. Your lower body, most joint angles should be at roughly 90 degrees.

2. To start, initiate the movement by taking a step to the rear, allowing your hips and knees to flex to lower your body. 

3. Contacting the back leg through only the ball of the foot, descend until your knee nearly touches the ground.
 
4. After a brief pause, as you return to the standing position by driving through the heel of the front leg to extend the knees and hips, kick your leg forward. 

5. Then back to the starting position.

6. Repeat.

2713.name: Inchworm Walk
2713.description:
1) Get into a plank position on your hands and toes, with arms straight, and core engaged. 

2) With very small steps from your ankles and hips, while keeping your knees straight, move your lower body forward. Try to keep your tailbone tipped up to the ceiling as best you can.  

3) Once you've gone as far as you can without bending your knees, set your feet in place. Then start walking your hands out in little steps until you've returned to a plank position. 

4) Repeat.

2717.name: Bear Crawl
2717.description:
(1) Start in a position similar to a plank, but with one side of your body's arm and leg far apart from one another (both extended), and one side of your body's arm and leg close together (touching knee to elbow on that side if possible). 

(2) From here, keep your body high while staying as square to the ground with your hips and shoulders as possible.

(3) Next, simultaneously reach as far forward as you can with the hand that is furthest back (the one touching your knee), and step forward with the foot furthest back (the one stretched out). Keep your core engaged. 

(4) Repeat alternating sides until provided reps or distances are completed.

2863.name: Fast Feet
2863.description:
1) For this exercise, have a slightly aggressive position, lean forward with your upper body.

2.) Move your feet in a run on the spot as fast as you can.

2865.name: SuperBand Thruster
2865.description:
1. Start by standing with feet shoulder-width apart, on the band, and the band in both hands. 

2. Squat down by reaching your hips back and bending your knees. Push yourself back upwards, using momentum to press the band directly up overhead. 

3. Slowly return to the start position under control and repeat.

5086616.name: Band Pull Aparts around Rig or Post

5086619.name: DB Tricep Kickback on Incline Bench

5089902.name: Face Pull on Rings or Jungle Gym

5089912.name: Incline DB Chest Fly with Chains

5089932.name: Full Range Mountain Climbers for DLP

5089940.name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust with Slingshots on

5109226.name: DB Chest Fly on Flat Bench

5110628.name: Ball Squat Jumps with Vertical Throw

5110634.name: DB Lunge Walks with DB's by side

5114277.name: KB Goblet Squat

6213217.name: High Knee Skipping
6213217.description:
1. Drive one of your knees upwards towards your chest.

2. While holding your knee in the upright position, come up onto the toes of the standing leg and do a small hop.

3. Continue by alternating legs, lifting the knee and bouncing on a single leg.

6245209.name: Lying Hip Abductions
6245209.description:
1. Start by lying on your side on the mat, with your elbow supporting your head.

2. Stack your knees, and bend the knee closest to floor, bringing that foot behind your body. 

3. Slowly raise the foot of your top leg into the air, directly in line with your body, then return to the start position under control. 

4. Repeat on the other side.

6251539.name: Mini Band Jumping Jack
6251539.description:
1. Place the band around the arches of both feet. 

2. Perform a jumping jack by jumping your feet outwards  while reaching your hands up overhead and together. 

3. Jump back to the start position and repeat.

6251605.name: Mini Band Squat Thrust
6251605.description:
1. Start by placing the band around the arches of both feet. 

2. Reach down to place your hands on the floor then jump your feet back so you land in a plank position. 

3. Jump your feet forward and stand back up to return to the starting position.

6252892.name: Bear Plank
6252892.description:
1. Start on your hands and knees on the mat.

2. Point your toes into the floor, and lift your knees 1 inch off the floor. 

3. Keep your shoulders directly over top of your hands, hips over knees, and abdominals tight. 

4. Hold this position.

6252967.name: Table Top Half Arm Thoracic Rotation
6252967.description:
1. Start on your hands and knees on the mat. 

2. Drop down to your elbows while keeping your hips directly over your knees. 

3. Place one hand behind your head, and reach the elbow of that hand towards the ceiling by rotating through your torso. 

4. Rotate completely the other way, reaching the elbow towards the mat. 

5. Repeat on the other side.

6253262.name: Walkouts
6253262.description:
1. Start by standing with feet shoulder-width apart. 

2. Reach your hands down towards the mat, and slowly walk your hands all the way out to a plank position.

3. While keeping your hips in line, and abdomen tight, walk your hands all the way back up to the standing position.

6379749.name: Smith Machine Sit Up
6379749.description:
1. Start by lying on your back, with the bar resting in your hands, in line with your chest. 

2. Flex your abdominals, drive your chest up towards the ceiling, and sit upwards.

3. Slowly control yourself back to the start position. Repeat.

6380127.name: Smith Machine Single Leg Squat
6380127.description:
1. Start by standing on a single leg, with the bar resting on your upper back. 

2. Descend into a squat on a single leg, while reaching your opposite foot forward. 

3. Press yourself back up to a standing position. 

4. Repeat on the opposite side.

6393353.name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squats
6393353.description:
1. Start with your rear foot elevated on a bench behind you, with the bar resting on your upper back.

2. Slowly descend into the hip, knee, and ankle of the front leg. 

3. Drive the floor away by pushing your entire front foot into the ground. Return to the start position.

4. Repeat on the other side.

6428209.name: Bent Knee Butt Raise on Bench

6428386.name: Ring Y-T-W's
6428386.description: If you do not have rings, you can use bands instead.

6449971.name: Ring Pullups with feet on ground
6449971.description: If you do NOT have access to rings, you can grab a barbell that is in the rack and perform the same movement.

6449976.name: Single Arm Bent Over Chain Row

6461753.name: Angled Machine Leg Press
6461753.description:
1. Start seated on the leg press machine, with feet shoulder-width apart on the plate. 

2. Slowly lower the weight towards your body, while keeping your lower back in the seat, as low as you can comfortably and under control. 

3. Push the weight back up to the start position. Avoid completely straightening or "locking out" the knees at the top. Repeat.

6461769.name: Angled Machine Sumo Leg Press
6461769.description:
1. Start seated on the leg press machine, with feet placed wider than shoulder-width apart on the plate. 

2. Slowly lower the weight towards your body, while keeping your lower back in the seat, as low as you can comfortably and under control. 

3. Push the weight back up to the start position. Avoid completely straightening or "locking out" the knees at the top. Repeat.

6461931.name: Machine Glute Kickback
6461931.description:
1. Start by resting your chest against the body pad, grasping the handles, with a single foot on the weight plate. 

2. Push the plate away, fully extending your knee and your hip. Squeeze the glutes for a moment, then return to the start position. 

3. Repeat on the other leg.

6461957.name: Machine Seated Abduction
6461957.description:
1.Sit upright in the machine with the leg pads at the outside of your knees with your knees together and your feet on the foot pegs.

2. Push your knees apart, bringing the pads away from each other.

3. Bring your knees back together, returning to starting position. Repeat.

6518042.name: Mini Band Alternating Side Steps (Squat Stance)
6518042.description:
1. Start by placing the Mini Band around your ankles, and descending into a half-squat position. 

2. While keeping your knees in line with your toes, reach one foot out to the side. Step back together, then reach the opposite foot out. 

3. Repeat this movement, while trying not to move up and down with your body.

6518238.name: Mini Band Mountain Climbers
6518238.description:
1. Start in a plank position, with the Mini Band looped around the middle of both feet.

2. Slowly draw one knee in towards your chest, then return to the start position. 

3. Continue alternating sides, while maintaining a strong plank position.

6529600.name: Weighted GHD Glute Extensions
6529600.description: If you do NOT have access to a GHD, you can perform a similar movement on a flat bench as is shown in this video - https://youtu.be/AysNBOQXYVA

6558785.name: DB Bent Over Row Iso Hold

6558889.name: Sling Shot Hip Thrust Knee Flares

6558929.name: Hand Supported Single Leg Romanian Deadlift

6584455.name: Mini Band Squat
6584455.description:
1. Start by standing with feet shoulder-width apart, with the band looped around both knees.  

2. Slowly reach your hips back and bend your knees like you're sitting in a chair. 

3. Return to the start position without letting the knees come inwards.

6584509.name: Mini Band Wall Sit
6584509.description:
1. Start by placing the band around both knees with your back against the wall.

2.Place your feet shoulder-width and slide your torso down the wall until you make a 90-degree angle with your hips and knees. 

3. Maintain this position for the desired time, without letting the knees collapse inwards.

6584659.name: SuperBand Overhead Reverse Lunge
6584659.description:
1. Start by standing with feet together, on the band, and the band in both hands. 

2. Press the band overhead. While maintaining this position, step one foot back into a lunge position. 

3. Push yourself up to return to the start position. Repeat on the other side.

6584766.name: Single Leg DB Romanian Deadlift with Band

6612035.name: Gripless High Face Pull with External Rotation

6612064.name: Banded Face Pull with External Rotation with Y Press

6612072.name: DB Chest Fly with Internal Rotation

6617097.name: SuperBand Reverse Lunge and Press
6617097.description:
1. Start bt standing with feet together on the band, with the band in both hands at chest height. 

2. Step one foot back and descend into a reverse lunge. 

3. Return to the start position by driving through the front foot.

4. Press the band directly overhead until your elbows are straight. 

5. Bring the hands back down to chest height and repeat.

6617149.name: Band Split Squat
6617149.description:
1. Start by standing on the band, with feet together, while holding it in both hands at chest height. 

2. Step one foot back and plant the toes on the ground. 

3. Slowly drop the back knee towards the floor, then push back up to the starting position without stepping together. 

4. Repeat on the opposite side.

6620872.name: Band Reverse Lunge
6620872.description:
1. Start by standing with feet together, on the band, and the band in both hands at shoulder height.

2. While maintaining this position, step one foot back into a lunge position.

3. Push yourself up to return to the start position. Repeat on the other side.

6620942.name: Band Bent Over Row
6620942.description:
1. Start by standing on the band with both feet planted roughly shoulder-width apart. 

2. Reach your hips backwards, with knees slightly bent, while maintaining a long spine position. 

3. Fully extend your arms towards the floor. Pull your hands back towards your body, opening the chest and bringing hands towards the hip crease. Repeat.

6620977.name: SuperBand Seated Row
6620977.description:
1) While seated on the floor with legs straight out in front of you, hold the handles.

2) Place the centre of the band around both of your feet.

3) Sit tall with abs tight and hold handles in front of you with elbows bent next to your side.

4) Pull the handles back until they are next to your side and elbows are behind you.

5) Slowly return to the start position and repeat.

6621114.name: SuperBand Deadlift
6621114.description:
1. Start by looping the band around the centre of both your feet. You can double up the band for additional tension. 

2. With the ends of the band in both hands, reach your hips back with slightly bent knees and a long spine position.

3. Drive your hips forward to return to the start position and repeat.

6621394.name: SuperBand Glute Kickback
6621394.description:
1. Start on all fours, with the band looped around one foot, and the hand on the same side. 

2. Fully extend the leg that is holding the band, squeezing the glute hard for a moment once the leg is straight. 

3. Slowly return to the start position. Repeat on the opposite side.

6663466.name: Hack Squat
6663466.description:
1. Start standing with the weight on your shoulders, and feet shoulder-width apart. 

2. Slowly lower down into a squat position, while keeping the lower back in contact with the pad. 

3. Go as low as you can comfortably go under control before returning to the start position.

7102024.name: Narrow Back Squat w/ 4" elevated heel

7102074.name: GHD Leg Extensions
7102074.description: If you do NOT have access to a GHD, simply do the leg extension machine at your gym. Or substitute with heels-elevated-squats as shown in this video - https://youtu.be/gGFTi0Vfa0k

7211291.name: SuperBand Anchored Squat to Row
7211291.description:
1. Start by securing a band to an anchor point at about chest height. 

2. While holding the band in both hands, do a squat by sitting back into your hips, knees, and ankles.

3. Return to the start position, then pull the handles towards your armpits, while keeping an "open chest" position. 

4. Repeat the squat, and the row, until you've completed all the repetitions.

7330497.name: Band Bicep Curl
7330497.description:
1) Stand with both feet on resistance band holding handles long next to your sides 

2) Slowly both hands up towards your shoulders, squeezing the biceps and keeping your elbows next to your sides. 

3) Slowly lower the arms back down towards the start position, then repeat.

9372999.name: Sideway Slingshot Walk - TKE Drop Lunge - Banded Leg Curls (SLTP)
9372999.description: No need to track this superset as it's all banded. Just remember which bands you used.

9373008.name: BB Deadlifts (SLTP)
9373008.description:
Perform 1-2 warmup sets with 10 reps at a light weight.

See how you feel, and gradually increase the weight. No need to track your warmup sets, your main goal here is to track your prescribed Rep-Max.

So what is the max weight you lifted for the reps prescribed?

If your prescribed Rep-Max was a 7 Rep-Max, but you tried 225 lbs and only hit 5 reps, then write track that instead.

The app will then keep track of your strength progression on this lift.

9373017.name: Blackburns - Hip Thrust - Leg Raises (SLTP)
9373017.description: On this superset, only track the amount of REPS you accomplish on the hanging leg raises for each set.

9373019.name: Crossbody Rear Fly - Ball Horizontal Throw (SLTP)

9373022.name: BB Bench Press with Chains (SLTP)
9373022.description:
Perform 1-2 warmup sets with 10 reps at a light weight.

See how you feel, and gradually increase the weight. No need to track your warmup sets, some weeks you might need 2 sets, other weeks you might need more.

Your main goal here is to track your prescribed 'Rep-Max'.

So what is the max weight you lifted for the reps prescribed?

9373026.description: On this superset, only track the WEIGHT you used for the entire set (since you'll be using the same DB's for all 5 exercises).

9373028.name: Left-side Shoulder Touch Pushups (SLTP)
9373028.description: Track each week how many reps you got.

9373029.name: Pistol Pushdowns - DB Waiter Curls (SLTP)
9373029.description: On this superset, track the weight you lifted on the DB Waiter Curls and how FAST you were able to complete all 200 reps of both exercises.

9373031.name: DB Bulgarian Iso Hold at 1-3-0
9373031.description:
You'll do this at a tempo of 1-3-0, meaning 1 second to go down... 3 second hold at the bottom... and explosively coming up.

Track the weight you lift each week (and use the same weight for each leg).

9373034.name: Leg Curls - Incline DB Shrugs
9373034.description:
If you don't have access to a GHD, do the slider leg curls (or any leg curl machine you can find).

On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Incline Shrugs for each set.

9373037.name: 1.5 KB/DB Goblet Squat
9373037.description:
Start with 1 set of 10 to 'find' your groove and see what weight you want to use.

Then you will do 1 set AMAP, going all out.

Track the weight you used and the reps you did on that 1 set each week.

9373039.name: Sprinter Situps - V-Ups - Reverse Crunches - Hollow Body Rocks
9373039.description: Whatever you do, do NOT stop in the middle of your set. Complete all 4 exercises in a row.

9373040.name: DB Flat Bench Press at 1-3-0 (SLTP)
9373040.description: Go down for 1 sec, Hold at bottom for 3 sec, and explosively drive weights up.

9373042.name: DB Rack Row - Band Pullaparts (SLTP)
9373042.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the DB Rack Row for each set.

9373045.name: Banded Pullups - Arnold Press (SLTP)
9373045.description:
Find which method of banded pullups works best for you.

Then on this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Arnold Press each week.

9375225.name: Right-side Shoulder Touch Pushups (SLTP)
9375225.description: Track how many reps you get each week.

9375277.name: Lower Body Mobility Routine
9375277.description:
This is the exact mobility flow I do myself before every lower body day. Your goal should be to learn this by heart, and most importantly - DO IT OFTEN

When you start lifting weight, it's easy to get stiff and sore - especially if you're sedentary throughout the day. This is why it's important you keep your circulation up. The more you 'move', the more supple you stay. Never stop moving.

9375575.name: Wide Pushups at 3-0-0 (SLTP)
9375575.description:
3 seconds to go down, no hold at the bottom, and fast up.

If possible, add weight over your back through either chains, a weighted vest, or plates.

9375658.name: Bent Over Row - Banded Y-T-W's (SLTP)
9375658.description:
You'll start this workout with another 'superset'.

If you don't know what this means, go back to your Phase 1 Day 1 workout and you'll see it there.

From now on, if you see multiple exercises in the title (and video), then that means you will be doing those exercises in a superset.

When it comes to these supersets, I only want you to track the weight you lift on 1 exercise.

In this case, the Bent Over Row.

This renders that exercise you track to be the 'main one', where the goal is to either lift heavier on that 'main one' every week (or do more reps, whatever the requirement is for that week).

9375662.name: DB Bench Press (SLTP)
9375662.description:
Perform 1-2 warmup sets with 10 reps at a light weight.

See how you feel, and gradually increase the weight. 

No need to track your warmup sets, some weeks you might need 2 sets, other weeks you might need more.

Your main goal here is to track your prescribed 'Rep-Max'.

So what is the max weight you lifted for the reps prescribed?

If your prescribed Rep-Max was a 7 Rep-Max, then how much weight can you lift for 7 reps?

And if you're prescribed a 7 Rep-Max, but you tried 225 lbs and only hit 5 reps, then record those reps x weights instead.

The app will then keep track of your strength progression on this lift.

9375663.name: Alternating DB Side Raises - Bent Elbow Shrugs - Pulley High Face Pull (SLTP)
9375663.description:
On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Alternating DB Side Raises for each set.

Then on the Shrugs and Face Pulls after, just go by 'feel' and get a nice pump. 

The Alternating DB Side Raises is the 'main one' on this superset.

9375664.name: Bar Bicep Curl - Incline Skullcrushers - Banded Kickbacks (SLTP)
9375664.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Bar Bicep Curl for each set.

9375701.name: RKC Plank - Side Plank - Hip Thrust (SLTP)
9375701.description:
You'll start this workout with what is called a 'superset'.

This means you will do 1 set of an exercise, followed by 1 set of a different exercise.

In this case, you'll be doing 3 exercises 'in a row' as shown in the video: 

RKC Plank to a Side Plank to a Hip Thrust.

For the RKC Plank, do 5 'squeezes' per set.

For the Side Plank, hold it for 30 sec per set (each side)

For the Hip Thrust, do 25 reps per set.

Then do that sequence for 3 sets.

This will be your very first 'superset' of the program. 

We will be using this method often (it allows you to do more 'work' in less time).

These exercises do not need to be tracked, as they are mostly bodyweight. And they primarily serve to 'activate' all the right muscles for your big squat coming up next.

(also, if you don't have Sling Shot - just do it without it for now. You can find them on Amazon for $30).

9375703.name: Low Bar Squat (SLTP)
9375703.description:
Start every week with 1 warmup set of 25 reps, either bodyweight or empty / light bar

Then in Week 1, take 3 sets to work up to a 7-Rep Max

This means you hit the MAX weight that you can do properly for 7 reps. 

So for instance, after your warmup, you might start with:

1 set of 7 at 135 lbs - and it goes easy

So you add 25's each side, and now you do 1 set of 7 at 185 lbs - and it's more challenging, but you can still do more...

Then add more weight, until you 'find' the max weight you can only lift for 7 reps...

This is called your '7-rep max'.

Heads-up:

You might need more than 3 sets to 'find' your 7 rep max, feel it out and listen to your body.

Always use safety spotters (usually squat racks have them built in)

Take long breaks in between these sets, this is your strength movement of the day.

Usually if you squat 7 reps and feel like you 'only had 1-2 more reps in you before you fail', then that's where you stop.

Then in week 2, you'll work up to a 6-Rep Max (going heavier, because less reps).

And in week 3, work up to a 5-Rep Max (again going heavier, this is how you'll get stronger on this lift).

9375705.name: DB Lungewalks with 1 Heavy DB on 1 side (SLTP)
9375705.description:
In week 1, you'll do 3 sets of 10 steps each leg (both sides).

The reps will be going down in the following weeks. So next week you'll be going heavier.

That's why in this week, focus on your mind-muscle connection. Feel every step in your glutes (butt) and quads (front side of your legs).

Track the weight you lift. 

And if you weren't able to hit 3 sets of 10 reps on the same weight this week, then track the sets and reps that you did do (along with the weight used).

9375709.name: BB Hip Thrust (SLTP)
9375709.description:
If you don't have a Hip Thrust pad yet, look for a 'squat sponge' on Amazon.

Or if you want something fancy - look for the 'Hip Thrust Pad' from Rogue Fitness (which can also serve as pad for other uses).

9375734.name: DB Bulgarians at 6-0-1 (SLTP)
9375734.description:
This will be your 'big lift' of the workout, and the 6-0-1 stands for:

6 seconds down
0 second hold (so go right back up)
1 second to come back up

Make sure you don't rest between reps, keep changing direction and don't 'catch your breath' at the top.

9375735.name: Weighted GHD Back Extension (SLTP)
9375735.description:
If you do not have access to a Glute Ham Developer (GHD), then look for either the 'leg curl' machine in the gym you're at.

Or try finding a '45 degree' back extension at yuor gym.

If you have neither of those, then perform slider leg curls as shown in the second exercise of this little clip: https://straightupfitness.wistia.com/medias/76qp9yzh66

9375739.name: Bodyweight Cossack Squats (SLTP)
9375739.description:
No need to really track the weight on this this one, as your volume will go up every week.

So I recommend actually doing it with bodyweight only.

And if you have a hard time going all the way down, you can hold on to something in front of you.

(it does help to stretch your calves good before this, as you probably already do anyway =))

9375741.name: Anti-Rotation Alphabet Spells (SLTP)
9375741.description:
Can be done on both Bands or Cable stacks.

If done on bands, track the band color.

If on cables, track the weight attached.

9375746.name: DB Farmers Walks (SLTP)
9375746.description:
First track the weight you have in your hands.

Then in your 'reps' simple track the distance you covered in your prescribed amount of seconds.

9375760.name: 1-Arm Lat Pulldown - Incline DB Rear Raises - Band Pullaparts (SLTP)
9375760.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the 1-Arm Lat Pulldown for each set.

9375766.name: Bar Bicep Curl - Pulley Tricep Pushdown (SLTP)
9375766.description:
Perform the prescribed reps in as little sets as possible.

Then track the weight lifted, and the time it took for you to complete all reps on BOTH exercises.

Then use the same weight each week, but try to take less breaks as you progress.

You can either do all biceps first, and then triceps. Or vice versa. Or switch it up, totally up to you.

9375774.name: Incline DB Bench Press at 6-0-1 (SLTP)
9375774.description:
Going down in 6 seconds (which is a LONG time with heavy weights)

Holding it for zero seconds at the bottom

Then launching it up in 1 second.

Count with Mis-sis-sip-pi seconds here!

9375776.name: 1-Arm DB Floor Press (SLTP)
9375776.description:
Make sure ONLY your tricep hits the ground, not your actual elbow.

This keeps the tension on the muscle, and helps your shoulders stay engaged.

9375781.name: L-Lateral Raise to Long Lever Eccentric (SLTP)
9375781.description:
The hardest part is when you stick your hands out and make yourself wide.

Brace your stomach and squeeze your butt before you get there.

We'll be using the same weight in all 3 weeks on this one (increasing the volume each week).

9376269.name: Bar Bicep Curl (PSR)
9376269.description: Track the weight you used and how fast you were able to get the prescribed reps in with good form.

9381663.name: Low Bar Squat Burnout Set (SLTP)
9381663.description:
Now take 50% of the heaviest you just lifted... and do ONE set till absolute failure.

('absolute failure' here meaning: stop right before you have to give up)

9381783.name: DB Bench Press Burnout Set (SLTP)
9381783.description:
Now take 50% of the heaviest you just lifted... and do ONE set till absolute failure.

('absolute failure' here meaning: stop right before you have to give up)

9404451.name: KB / DB Goblet Squat (PSR)
9404451.description:
Perform 1-2 warmup sets with 10 reps at a light weight.

See how you feel, and gradually increase the weight. 

No need to track your warmup sets, some weeks you might need 2 sets, other weeks you might need more.

Your main goal here is to track your prescribed 'Rep-Max'.

So what is the max weight you lifted for the reps prescribed?

If your prescribed Rep-Max was a 7 Rep-Max, then how much weight can you lift for 7 reps?

And if you're prescribed a 7 Rep-Max, but you tried 225 lbs and only hit 5 reps, then record those reps x weights instead.

The app will then keep track of your strength progression on this lift.

9409518.name: Bodyweight Dips (PSR)
9409518.description:
We'll be doing these for 3 sets - 1 medium, 1 heavy, and 1 medium again.

Start by determining whether you need a band or not.

Then you can make it more challenging by going lighter on the band... going no band... or even adding weight by wrapping a chain around your neck, or wearing a weight belt with chains hanging from it.

Since this is a high-rep exercise this week (as it's Deload Week), I recommend staying light.

9409529.name: BB Hip Thrust (PSR)
9409529.description:
You'll be doing 20 at a 'medium' weight... followed by 10 at a heavier weight... then back to 20 reps on your initial medium weight.

The goal here is to complete all prescribed reps without stopping the set.

9409530.name: Pulley Lat Pulldowns (PSR)
9409530.description:
You'll be doing 20 at a 'medium' weight... followed by 10 at a heavier weight... then back to 20 reps on your initial medium weight.

The goal here is to complete all prescribed reps without stopping the set.

9474686.name: Banded Good Mornings - DB Leg Curls on Bench - Incline DB Rows(SLTP)
9474686.description:

The 2 other exercises can be autoregulated (done by 'feel')

9474688.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Single Leg Deadlift for each set.

9474692.description: Straight Sets on this one - keeping your body up between 'butt squeezes', never laying down until the set it over.

This way each leg gets the proper amount of rest.

9508595.name: 90 degree Iso Chinup Hold - 1.5 Incline DB Curls - DB Hammer Curls (SLTP)
9508595.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the 1.5 Incline Curls for each set.

9508605.name: Offset Farmers Walks (SLTP)
9508605.description:
Remember to keep the heavy DB/KB on the low side. 

And you keep everything tight while changing direction, this is a great exercise for core strength.

9508606.name: Weighted DB Step-Ups - DB Single Leg Deadlifts (SLTP)
9508606.description:
On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Step-Up for each set.

Then try using that same weight for the Single LEg Deadlifts right after.

So do left leg step-ups, followed by left leg deadlifts...

Rest 60 sec

Then do right leg step-ups, followed by right leg deadlifts...

Rest 60 sec

And that's 1 set.

9508859.description:
When calculating the weight, the barbell is usually 45 lbs.

So on this exercise you will squat your own bodyweight...

If you weigh 225 lbs... then you will put 225-45=180 lbs on the bar

That means 180/2 = 90 lbs each side.

9602280.description:
Perform the prescribed amount of reps for this exercise in as little sets as possible.

Then track the weight lifted and how long it took you to complete those reps.

9677727.name: Bodyweight Jump Squat Finisher (PSR)
9677727.description:
Perform the prescribed amount of reps for this exercise in as little sets as possible.

Then track how long it took you to complete those reps.

9684763.name: BB Sumo Deadlift (PSR)
9684763.description: Use the same weight on every rep of every set.

13125871.name: Landmine Single Leg Squat
13125871.description: Every week you'll perform more sets and reps. The goal is to use the same weight every week.

13125894.name: Narrow Pullup
13125894.description:
This is your other 'Big Lift' of the day

It doesn't matter which method you choose in doing these, however make sure to stick to the same method every week.

The goal here is to complete the prescribed reps faster every week. 

Pullups keep you honest! If you can't do them yet, it's probably because you weigh too much. So inadvertently this will make you think twice about eating those cookies diabetic Debbie brought into the lunchroom. 

Spray windex on those cookies and do pullups instead, diabetes is not something I would recommend anyway.

13125959.name: Box Jump
13125959.description:
There is no better way of 'activating' your body for a heavy leg day than box jumps.

Not only do they force you to RAISE your knees up, they also have you take a mental risk of jumping on top of something.

If you struggle with this, start low. And if you find that you just can't get yourself to jump - you should know that it's 100% mental. If you keep trying, you will eventually do it.

And when you do, that feeling will be so, so sweet.

Keep practicing. And if you already conquered one height, go higher.

13125973.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
13125973.description:
You can see the exact instructions in the video, but one thing I forgot to mention - push your stomach out a little bit.

This applies to any time you stick your butt out - if you extend your stomach to the front a little, it helps maintain a natural curve in your lower back.

So inhale, put that air in your stomach. Then lock it in by pushing your belly button out a little bit.

Then stick your butt out backwards, grab that bar and boom boom. Row it to the top row of your 6-pack.

Same weight every week (the sets x reps will go up)

13125977.name: Forward Broad Jumps
13125977.description:
The thing with broad jumps (and any explosive lift in general really), is that the first 1-2 sets always kinda suck.

It's that 2nd and 3rd set where your muscles are awake and you start getting smooth.

So if you feel like an old person on your first set, just know that your second set will have you feeling 10 years younger.

Unfortunately, most people never make it to that second set.

Sofia Vergara does though. She always makes it to the third set.

13126051.name: Barbell Deadlift
13126051.description:
The one exercise that uses THE most amount of muscle per rep.... the Barbell Deadlift

Quick tips here:

- Pull your hands towards your legs / shins
- Push your bellybutton out and keep your chest up
- Once the bar is off the floor, accelerate that bar as FAST as possible, squeezing your butt hard at the top

Goal here is a 6 Rep Max, go heavy!

13127516.name: Dumbbell Pullover
13127516.description:
The big mistake people make here is bringing that Dumbbell all the way towards their chest / stomach area

Keep it behind you, and really 'reach' for the floor almost. Feel that stretch in your lats, then 'pull' against that stretch to tear that muscle apart. But keep the tension on there.

Stick with the same weight in the phase, you're addin sets x reps later.

13127532.name: Ball Woodchoppers - DB Rear Lunge - Landmine Squats
13127532.description:
Perform these 3 warmup exercises in a row without stopping in between.

You only rest after the landmine squats. After which you do the ball woodchoppers again to start another set.

Since this is a warmup, there's no need to track weights - but if you feel like it, track what you lifted on the landmine squats (and make sure to push your knees OUT on those squats, feeling that stretch in your inner thighs as you go down).

13127534.name: DB Bugarians - BB Glute Bridges
13127534.description:
Since this is Deload, we're going straight into an accessory 'superset' 

(you should know what that means by now, but if you don't - message me)

On this superset, both exercises will build your butt.

But only if you push it hard like Salt n Pepa did in the 90's

The Glute Bridge allows you to go heavy too, since it's so low to the floor. Only track the weight you lift on the glute bridge here.

13127537.name: Landmine Floor Raises w/ Calf Extensions
13127537.description:
Put your all into this one - prepare yourself mentally and make sure to keep breathing throughout your 30 reps.

Add in a bonus calf extension at the top for extra credit. Extra credit which you can exchange later for nicer looking calves, and better ankle flexibility.

This might just be the most stress-relieving exercise out there.

13127539.name: Jump Rope Sprints
13127539.description:
The goal here is to finish the prescribed amount of 'jumps' in the shortest amount of time. 

Every Deload week we'll be adding 250 jumps to the set, so the goal really is to keep your time the same (getting faster)

Quick tip: If you don't have a jumprope yet, or you have one that sucks - I really like the Thai  Jumprope from Rogue Fitness (they're a little heavier, but train your forearms and have a good rhythm)

13127541.name: 1 Arm DB Shoulder Press - 1 Arm DB Row - Pullup Iso Hold
13127541.description:
On this superset, log both the weights you lifted for the presses and rows... AND how many seconds you were able to hold that pullup position

Holding a pullup halfway is an awesome technique to increase your pullup strength

(if you currently weigh too much to hold a pullup, find a lower bar and perform this with your feet on the ground and use your arms to hold yourself up as much as possible)

13127552.name: 1 Arm Farmers Walks
13127552.description:
The goal here is to cover the most amount of distance in 90 seconds.

So log not only the weight you lift, but also how many feet you actually walked in those 90 seconds.

Obviously, do one side first. Then rest, and do the other side.

The goal here is to cover more distance every Deload week (keeping the weight of the Dumbbell the same).

14839564.name: Broad Jump
14839564.description: Jump forward with both feet together, landing softly and immediately jumping back into the next rep. Focus on explosive power.

15081926.name: Landmine Rotation To Press
15081926.description:
Hold the barbell with both hands. Rotate your torso to one side, then return to center and press the barbell overhead. 

Repeat on the other side.

15246897.name: Alternating Lunge Hops
15246897.description: Perform jumping lunges, switching legs mid-air for an explosive movement.

15873458.name: Laying Hamstring Curl
15873458.description: Lie face down on the hamstring curl machine. Place your ankles under the pad. Curl the pad toward your glutes by bending your knees, then slowly lower back down.

16649012.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
16649012.description:
Stand tall holding a dumbbell vertically close to your chest with both hands, elbows pointing down. Keep your chest up and core engaged. 

Step your feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping the dumbbell close to your chest, until your thighs are parallel to the floor (or as low as comfortable). 

Push through your heels to return to standing.
